overview.description: The WisdomTree Japan Hedged Equity Fund (DXJ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the WisdomTree Japan Hedged Equity index. The fund tracks an exporter-focused, dividend-weighted index of Japanese stocks. The fund is hedged for currency fluctuations between the USD and JPY. DXJ was launched on Jun 16, 2006 and is issued by WisdomTree.
